method: Ranked by how much news coverage each case got in the last 72 hours, from our daily trending scan. It is a measure of attention, not of guilt. Each status below comes from our sourced court calendar, not from the scan.

cases.title: Maggie and Paul Murdaugh: Alex Murdaugh's retrial
cases.why: His 2023 murder convictions were overturned in May 2026. A judge heard his motion to dismiss the murder charges on Nov. 13. The retrial is set for April 2027 in Sumter County. He is presumed innocent of the murder charges.

cases.title: The Lindsay Clancy case
cases.why: Her trial ended in a mistrial on Sept. 4, 2026, which is not a verdict. On Nov. 9 the judge denied her motion to dismiss. No retrial date is set. She remains charged, has pleaded not guilty and is presumed innocent.

cases.title: The Idaho student murders: the Bryan Kohberger case
cases.why: Kaylee Goncalves, Madison Mogen, Xana Kernodle and Ethan Chapin were killed in 2022. Kohberger pleaded guilty and was sentenced to life without parole in July 2025. A post-conviction petition is pending.

cases.title: The Jared Bridegan case
cases.why: A jury found Mario Fernandez Saldana guilty of first-degree murder on Aug. 26, 2026. We have not confirmed a sentencing date. Shanna Gardner and Henry Tenon are charged and presumed innocent; their trial is set for 2027.
